content:
This information is not new, but it hasn't been announced here before.

During May 6 - August 16, 2024 there will be a Trimester Program in Bonn: Prospects of formal mathematics [edit: linkfix]. A trimester program is a special meeting where ~30 mathematicians in a particular area of mathematics come together to discuss and collaborate.

It is open for senior mathematicians, postdocs and PhD students. The application deadline is 31 October 2023.

As part of the trimester program, there are 4 weeks with extra schools/workshops:
School on Formal Mathematics (May 13 - 17 2024)
Workshop: Formalization of Mathematics (June 17 - 21, 2024)
Workshop: Bridging between informal and formal (July 8 - 12, 2024)
Workshop: Libraries of Digital Math (July 29 - August 2, 2024)
